summary.zh: 按高管视角组织董事会材料与坏消息
summary.en: Structure a board deck or investor update from every executive's view.

description.zh: 把季度董事会材料按 CEO、CFO、COO 等视角组织成有结论的叙事，每个部分都写明负责人和观点。适合准备季度董事会、投资人更新或 QBR 时使用。缺少的数字会保留占位，不会自行编造。
description.en: Builds a board narrative owned by each executive role, with a headline and so-what per section. Use it before a board meeting, investor update, or QBR. Missing figures stay as placeholders, not invented numbers.
